info.title: The 5 Things to Look For
info.subtitle: A plain-language map of what your hearing chart is showing

rows.title: Pitch, left to right
rows.desc: Low tones on the left, high tones on the right.

rows.title: Loudness, top to bottom
rows.desc: Softer sounds up top, louder ones toward the bottom.

rows.title: Right ear vs left
rows.desc: O marks the right ear, X marks the left.

rows.title: Degree of loss
rows.desc: How far down the marks sit, mild to profound.

rows.title: Shape of the line
rows.desc: Flat or sloping, hinting at the pattern of loss.
